text:
Leah: Quick heads up — NovaHealth renewal next week. They're asking for a 50ms p95 SLA for generation endpoints + a dedicated cap commitment.
Mike: that's tight. our baseline p95 for that model is ~80ms in hosted right now. :grimacing:
Sasha: customer is high-touch, legal says this is a deal driver. they want contract language today if possible.
Ana: we should run a RICE-style check before committing. impact is high (revenue), reach is small (one customer), confidence medium, effort high.
Jordan: agree. leaning toward a temporary carve-out pilot vs full roadmap pull. can we propose a timeboxed SLA for 90 days while we instrument metrics and optimize?
Samir: technically we can offer a limited SLA if we scope it: restrict to certain regions, smaller qps, and a pinned model variant. also need dedicated queue and KV cache warm-up.
Leah: ok — propose 3 options to the customer: 1) timeboxed pilot (90d) with pinned model + capped QPS; 2) dedicated reserved capacity (higher commit); 3) lower-latency best-effort SLA + credits. which should we prioritize for internal sign-off?
Mike: from eng POV: rank by effort 1) pilot (medium), 2) best-effort w/credits (low), 3) reserved capacity (high procurement + infra). pilot gets us observability gains.
Ana: i'll draft a quick RICE calc in the thread — simplified.
Ana: R: 1 (one customer), I: 8 (strategic logo), C: 6 (we can probably do pilot), E: 7 (eng + infra work)
Ana: RICE score ~ (1*8*6)/7 = ~6.9 => medium priority but with high strategic importance.
Sasha: customer will accept a pilot if it's explicit about scope. ask: can we guarantee no regressions vs current outputs? they care about quality too.
Samir: quality-wise we can pin model weights and enforce eval harnesses for regressions. need 2 weeks to build canary plus smoke tests.
Jordan: decision: propose the 90d pilot as primary ask, include an option to convert to reserved capacity after successful metrics. legal to draft SLA language for pilot only.
Leah: nice. Ana + Samir work up the pilot plan and acceptance criteria. Sasha will prep messaging to NovaHealth. Mike — any blockers for engineering resourcing?
Mike: need one backend eng + one infra SRE for 3 weeks to build queue + metrics. can reallocate from current sprint if PMs agree.
Leah: i'll flag this in tomorrow triage and ask PMs to reprioritize if leadership signs off. Sasha, loop in the customer with these 3 options and call out the pilot timeline.
Sasha: on it. i'll send the draft and ping legal for pilot SLA wording. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled: legal review requested — tag @legal-team (auto)
Leah: thanks team. we'll treat this as negotiated escalation — don't change roadmap epics until we have a signed pilot. if converted, we re-evaluate RICE and sequencing.
